purpose: Post-hoc descriptive native-profile width audit of the31 events promoted from mapping-limited to unresolved. Original candidate data already seen; neither blind validation nor new search.
model: Positive Gaussian plus linear background evaluated at native wavelength samples; no response deconvolution or photon-noise likelihood.
nominal_reference_fwhm: lambda_topocentric_air/115000, matching frozen detector assumption; not a measured instrumental LSF.
background_methods: Joint linear background and Gaussian over all available41 native samples
Linear background from first8 and last8 samples, held fixed for Gaussian fit over all41
fit: Unweighted least squares, positive amplitude; retain upper/lower-width and center boundaries. No significance or uncertainty intervals because native error/LSF model is unverified.
descriptive_summary: Report all order/method widths, and number of events where every available complete order has both width ratios>2. This is a scale description, never an origin veto.
limitations: Absorption forests, blended/neighbor lines, low continuum, finite cutout and model mismatch affect widths. A broad feature can contain a narrow component; no exclusion of added lasers follows.
